home.title: PastPins — your travels, on your iPhone
home.description: An offline travel atlas for iPhone. Keep the places you have been and the places you want to go in one personal map.
home.heading: Your travels. A place to keep them.
home.intro: Keep track of where you’ve been, where you’ve lived, and where you want to go.
home.status: In development · Not yet available on the App Store
home.mapText: Explore a globe, a world map, and regional maps. Mark places as Visited, Lived, or Wishlist, and group them into your own lists.
home.offlineText: Your travel record lives on your iPhone. Browse and edit without an account or internet connection. Export a backup to keep a copy somewhere else.
home.choiceText: Share a map, a list, or a collection of stamps. Location and country arrival reminders are optional; you can use the atlas without either.
home.aboutText: PastPins is open source. Explore the code, contribute an improvement, or get in touch for help.
home.licenseText: The source is available under GNU GPL version 3 or later, with additional permission for Apple App Store distribution. Third-party materials keep their own licenses.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — PastPins
privacy.description: How PastPins handles local travel data, optional location, backups, support emails, and visits to this website.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: PastPins is an iPhone travel atlas developed by Kyle Deliyannides. This policy covers the app and this website. You do not need an account, and the app has no advertising, analytics, or developer-operated server that receives your travel record.
privacy.localText: Travel records: country and region statuses, home country, lists, and preferences are saved locally to display your atlas and remember your choices.
privacy.recoveryText: Recovery copies: up to three previous saved records are kept on your device before data upgrades or backup imports.
privacy.diagnosticsText: Diagnostics: up to 50 recent technical events contain versions, timestamps, and error codes. They exclude travel records, list names, coordinates, and raw errors. Nothing is uploaded automatically; you can export diagnostics for support.
privacy.locationText: Finding your current country requires location permission. It uses Apple’s native geocoding service, which may send location information to Apple, and an offline map fallback. Apple’s privacy policy covers its handling of this information.
privacy.remindersText: Arrival reminders are off by default. If enabled and permitted, iOS provides background location so PastPins can identify the country offline and show a local notification. You confirm before your travel record changes.
privacy.reminderStorageText: The app saves the last detected country and reminder times, not a trail of coordinates. No developer server receives your location.
privacy.permissionsText: You can disable reminders in PastPins and change location or notification permissions in iPhone Settings. Browsing and editing your atlas do not require those permissions.
privacy.sharingText: You choose where to share backups, saved data, diagnostics, and images through iOS. Backups and saved-data exports contain your travel record, list names, and preferences. The app attempts to remove temporary export files after sharing; the recipient or service you choose handles the copies you send.
privacy.backupsText: PastPins has no app-managed cloud sync. Depending on your iPhone settings, iOS or computer backups may include app data. Copies in iCloud, Files, email, or other destinations are governed by those services and are not removed when you reset PastPins.
privacy.contactText: Emails to Kyle Deliyannides are received through Microsoft Outlook. Your address, message, and attachments are used to answer you and troubleshoot. Correspondence is kept only as long as needed for support or legal obligations. You can request deletion. Send a travel backup only if needed and you are comfortable sharing it.
privacy.rightsText: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, copy, delete, restrict, or object to the use of personal information, and to complain to a privacy authority. Email the address below to make a request.
privacy.localRightsText: The developer cannot access or delete records stored only on your iPhone or in backups you control.
privacy.retentionText: Travel data remains until you change or delete it. Newer recovery copies replace older ones; diagnostics discard the oldest events when the log reaches its limit. In Settings and Data and recovery:
privacy.clearText: Clear travel data removes places, lists, home, and recovery copies. It keeps preferences and reminder history.
privacy.resetText: Reset app clears saved app data, settings, reminder history, diagnostics, and temporary backups.
privacy.preferencesText: Reset preferences keeps travel data and disables arrival reminders.
privacy.deletionText: iOS Delete App removes local app data; Offload App keeps documents and data. Manage exported files, device backups, and iOS permissions separately. To delete information sent for support, email the developer.
privacy.websiteText: GitHub Pages hosts this site and logs visitors’ IP addresses for security. This site adds no analytics, advertising, forms, cookies, third-party scripts, or fonts.
privacy.providersText: External links and services have their own privacy practices. Hosting and email providers may process information outside your country.
privacy.childrenText: PastPins is not directed at children under 13. The developer does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has sent personal information through support, contact the address below so it can be addressed and deleted where appropriate.
privacy.changesText: This policy will change when data practices change. Material changes will be explained here and, where appropriate, in the app before taking effect. For questions or privacy requests, contact Kyle Deliyannides:

support.title: Support — PastPins
support.description: Contact PastPins support and get help with backups, data recovery, permissions, and country arrival reminders.
support.heading: PastPins support
support.intro: For help, feedback, accessibility issues, or privacy requests, email Kyle Deliyannides.
support.emailHelp: Include your iPhone model, iOS version, PastPins version from Settings → About, and what happened. Remove private information from screenshots. A travel backup is usually not needed.
support.availabilityText: PastPins is currently in development for iPhone and is not yet available on the App Store. The instructions below describe the current app. iPad is not supported.
support.backupTitle: How do I keep a backup?
support.backupText: In PastPins Settings, choose Export backup and save the file somewhere outside the app. Use Restore backup to import a PastPins backup and review the replacement before confirming. There is no account or automatic app-managed cloud sync. Local recovery copies cannot protect against losing your iPhone or deleting the app.
support.recoveryText: Try again or update the app. In the recovery screen or Settings → Data and recovery, export your saved file before restoring a backup or recovery copy. An unreadable file may need repair. Email support before resetting if you need help preserving your data.
support.resetTitle: How do I delete my data?
support.resetText: Clear travel data removes places, lists, home, and recovery copies, but keeps preferences and reminder history. Reset app deletes all saved app data and returns to the welcome screen. Files you exported and device backups are separate; delete those in their saved locations if you no longer want them.
support.coldResetText: If an installed PastPins build cannot open, go to iPhone Settings → Apps → PastPins and enable Reset on Next Launch. Close PastPins from the app switcher, then reopen it. This erases local data and recovery copies. Use it only when you are ready to lose that local data; it does not restore a backup automatically.
support.remindersTitle: Why didn’t an arrival reminder appear?
support.remindersText: Check the reminder setting in PastPins and its location and notification permissions in iPhone Settings. iOS controls background delivery; reminders can be delayed or missed, especially after force-quitting. Reopen PastPins to resume.
support.reminderTimingText: Visited or Lived places do not trigger reminders. Repeat reminders require leaving and returning after at least seven days. Do not rely on reminders for border or safety alerts.
support.mapsTitle: A country or region looks wrong
support.mapsText: Country and region boundaries come from public cartographic datasets. Coverage and source dates vary, and maps are not an official government registry. Tell us which place needs attention. Include a public source if you have one, and avoid sharing your current location unless you want to.
